interactables.text: The [Police Officer]'s radio crackles: 'Lockdown initiated. [8:15 PM]. No one in or out.'
The [Manager] shouts into his phone: 'A missing parrot?! Do you know what this does to her brand?! It's a [PR Disaster]!'
A formal sign-in book by the entrance. Everyone logged their arrival. One entry stands out: '[D. Marsh] — [6:30 PM].' Half an hour before he officially signed in his cases.

localDeductionSentence: The [Police Officer] locked down the mansion at [8:15 PM], long after the bird had gone quiet — leaving the [Manager] to turn a [PR Disaster] into a phone call.
